title: The Tractor with Two Big Back Wheels
synopsis: Molly welcomes Rex, Gus and Jack to the farm hayfield, where Farmer Ruth pulls a waiting wagon with her red tractor.
continuity_state: Before: The Little Bridge is open and Rex and Molly are friends. The hayfield south of the red barn has not been introduced. After: Green Gate Farm now has a hayfield south of the red barn; Farmer Ruth owns a red tractor with two large rear tires and smaller front tires, and has moved an empty low hay wagon to its staging place by the barn. Jack draws the tractor and the farm route.
